items.text:
Application source commit: acca17e2b9389b1ba7efdfd99a10270857740125
See application/docs/BUILD.md for application builds and upstream FFmpeg-Builds/Termux/youtubedl-android build recipes for native libraries. Original upstream native binaries were not rebuilt in this mission. Archive manifests retain exact fetched source URLs/hashes. The Termux recipe snapshot was selected from upstream runtime dates; upstream does not provide a complete native build lockfile. Do not infer byte-identical native reproducibility. No private state, media or signing keys are included.
